caption: The drawing depicts a wrought iron fence or railing, primarily rendered in shades of blue and gray. The central section features a circular motif with six evenly spaced radiating spokes, each flanked by decorative leaf-shaped elements, giving a symmetrical, ornamental appearance. The railing is bordered on the top and bottom by two horizontal bars, with a diamond lattice pattern running along both edges. Vertical bars fill the gaps in the main frame, while the rightmost post is bulkier and distinguished by a circular cutout. The structure is shown standing on four conical feet. In the background, faint outlines suggest the presence of architectural elements such as columns and a wall. In the lower left corner, there is a small separate illustration resembling the central circular motif with spokes, possibly a design detail of the railing. The composition is contained within a thin rectangular border, and the overall color palette is monochromatic, using various tones of blue-gray for shading and definition.
title: Iron Gate and Fence
